summary.title: Profile
summary.content:
Principal-level product, backend, and platform engineer with 19+ years of experience building product-critical systems across SaaS, startups, and founder-led environments. Strongest hands-on depth in Node.js, TypeScript, full-stack product development, event-driven architecture, monetization systems, performance, and technical design.

At Riverside, I helped evolve the backend from a monolith toward more observable, event-driven services while staying close to architecture, system design, and technical sign-off. Most recently, I built AI-native products end to end with Next.js and React during a career sabbatical.

items.description:
• Built Verba, Informia, and FallosES using on-device transcription and local LLMs, vision models with evidence scoring, and grounded agentic search.

  • Built end-to-end products with Next.js, React, and Vercel, including long-running workflow patterns for multi-step AI and browser tasks.

  • Advised a stealth startup founder in a fractional CTO-style engagement, defining product scope, technical stack, database architecture, and an initial POC.

roles.position: Senior Engineering Manager (Internal Title: Group Lead)
roles.description:
• Acted as an architectural reviewer across my group and partner teams, driving design reviews and technical sign-off for complex backend and platform changes.

  • Guided the backend evolution from a monolith to event-driven architecture with Kafka and Protobuf, improving reliability, observability, and team autonomy.

  • Stayed hands-on while leading a zero-downtime migration of millions of active sessions from legacy sessions to JWT authentication, with API Gateway validation and Redis-backed session state.

• Split critical services from the monolith and introduced end-to-end observability across backend services and Kafka flows, contributing to a 33% reduction in overall system latency.

  • Designed and shipped an event-driven token ledger supporting AI feature billing and usage-based monetization.

  • Helped Riverside's mobile team integrate RevenueCat with our backend billing, entitlements, and payment systems.

• Built full-stack features across Studio, exporting, clips, dashboard, account, and media workflows, including the original Media Board with WebSocket-controlled playback and supporting storage services.

  • Took ownership of billing, payments, plans, features, and entitlements, evolving an early Stripe-and-webhooks setup into a more robust internal monetization model.

items.description: • Co-founded and led technical vision for a WebRTC video platform, gaining deep hands-on experience with streaming systems and cross-platform product development.
• Co-founded and led a 6-person digital agency for 11 years, delivering web, mobile, and interactive work globally.

items.name: Verba
items.description: Built a local-first speech-to-text app for macOS, including the product flow, licensing model, and on-device transcription pipeline. Combined transcription with local language-model cleanup so users can dictate without sending audio to the cloud.

items.name: Informia
items.description: Built an AI-assisted workflow for property registry processes in Argentina, covering document extraction, review, and browser-assisted submission. Extracts key fields from scanned deeds, shows supporting evidence, and uses context caching to reduce operating cost.

items.name: FallosES
items.description: Built a legal research assistant for Spain with a WhatsApp interface, lightweight web app, and grounded search over official sources. Maintains context and returns cited answers with concise summaries.
